findings.title: A stored session catalog masks later successful discovery for the same config
reproduction: Allow successful catalog C1 on tab A.
Create/switch to tab B; A captures nonempty C1 with config signature K.
Complete a normal successful Codex login in B and let the automatic catalog refresh produce changed advertised catalog C2 under the same executable/node signature K.
Switch to A after refresh completes.
findings.actual_static_result: _restore_agent chooses p_session.model_catalog=C1 solely because session config K matches current K and C1 is nonempty; the current discovered_model_catalogs[K]=C2 branch is not evaluated. A displays stale advertised IDs/efforts while a new tab uses C2.
findings.impact: Removed models and changed reasoning capabilities can remain advertised in old sessions after login auto-refresh. Independent selection preservation does not require old advertised catalog restoration.
findings.guards_checked: This is a normal completed refresh followed by an allowed tab switch. Neither models_loading guards nor request_generation cancellation prevent the branch.
findings.certainty: Static deterministic under changed catalog C2; no GUI/runtime reproduction performed.
findings.test_gap: New session-reuse case observes only one discovery, then a connection change. It never refreshes K a second time before revisiting an archived nonempty session.

findings.title: A response can be cached under a config that did not launch it
preconditions: Two ordinary non-self-contained editor windows share the documented effective runtime configuration.
Relevant Codex/node path is configuration-derived, not pinned by startup environment override.
A model-list query remains in flight during a normal valid path edit in the other idle window.
reproduction: A launches model discovery from effective runtime config K1.
B edits shared Codex/node paths to valid config K2 while A waits for the model-list response.
A receives successful K1 catalog after the shared config edit.
findings.actual_static_result: A request_generation remains current because B changes only shared configuration, not A local request state. _models_completed validates generation at4687 but recomputes current effective config K2 at4732 and stores K1 response in discovered_model_catalogs[K2] at4736. New tab restores K2 with K1 advertised catalog.
findings.guards_checked: The local UI is correctly locked by _set_busy:1581-82; GongGongPanel::set_runtime_field:266 also rejects local API changes while task_locked. Therefore a same-window forced signal edit is not claimed as a valid reproduction. These per-window guards do not lock another idle window. read_effective() reloads the shared config document each call; _models_completed has no launch-signature comparison.
findings.certainty: Static deterministic under the documented cross-window config-change preconditions; no live multi-window/runtime reproduction performed.

validation: Static control-flow review only. No runtime reproduction of these two findings is claimed. Same-window task locking was explicitly considered; the second finding requires a separate ordinary window editing shared durable configuration.
